title: 3rd International Digital Art Biennial – THE ONE
description: Submit digital graphics or short videos on the future of our planet. Free, for professional artists and art students worldwide.
descriptionDetailed: The 3rd edition of Pinata Foundation's biennial explores the future of our planet through digital art. It accepts digital graphics and videos or animations up to 3 minutes from professional artists and art students; AI-created works are excluded. Free to enter, with qualifying works exhibited in Poland and published in a bilingual catalog.

prize.description: 1st prize 3,000 PLN, 2nd prize 2,000 PLN, 3rd prize 1,000 PLN, plus honorable mentions. Qualifying works are shown in the post-competition exhibitions in Toruń and Włocławek and featured in a bilingual catalog with an ISBN.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For professional artists and art students worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: The competition accepts works by professional artists and art students from around the world, created using digital techniques. Works must not be created using artificial intelligence. Each participant may send 1 to 3 digital works by email.
